entities.summary: Emil Pettersson is a Swedish professional ice hockey player for Timrå IK of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). Pettersson was selected by the Nashville Predators in the sixth round of the 2013 NHL entry draft. Emil's brother Elias was drafted fifth overall by the Vancouver Canucks in the 2017 NHL entry draft.
